plugins.verifyConditionsCmd: cd frontend && flutter pub get && flutter analyze --no-pub lib 2>&1 | tee /tmp/analyze.log; if grep -q 'error •' /tmp/analyze.log; then echo 'ERROR: Found compile errors in lib/'; exit 1; fi
plugins.prepareCmd: BUILD_NUM=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER && echo "BUILD_NUM=$BUILD_NUM" && sed -i "s/^version: .*/version: ${nextRelease.version}+$BUILD_NUM/" frontend/pubspec.yaml && sed -i "s/versionName .*/versionName \"${nextRelease.version}\"/" frontend/android/app/build.gradle && sed -i "s/versionCode .*/versionCode $BUILD_NUM/" frontend/android/app/build.gradle && sed -i "s/embbytokVersion = .*/embbytokVersion = '${nextRelease.version}';/" frontend/lib/utils/version.dart && sed -i "s/embbytokBuildNumber = .*/embbytokBuildNumber = $BUILD_NUM;/" frontend/lib/utils/version.dart && sed -i "s/__version__ = .*/__version__ = '${nextRelease.version}'/" backend/core/version.py && sed -i "s/__build_number__ = .*/__build_number__ = $BUILD_NUM/" backend/core/version.py && echo '=== 版本文件已更新 ===' && grep '^version:' frontend/pubspec.yaml && grep 'versionName\|versionCode' frontend/android/app/build.gradle
